name: AWS
label: AWS JSON/REST (SigV4)
description: AWS service APIs via OfficialApiNode with AWS SigV4. Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/. Set config service to the SigV4 service code for this instance (s3, lambda, sqs, sns, dynamodb, ses, iam, secretsmanager, monitoring, ecs, sts, events). Operations: bucket_create, bucket_delete, bucket_list, object_get, object_put, object_delete, object_copy, object_list, lambda_invoke, sqs_send, sqs_receive, sqs_delete, sns_publish, dynamodb_get, dynamodb_put, dynamodb_query, ses_send, iam_get, iam_get_role, secretsmanager_get, cloudwatch_put, ecs_run, sts_assume, eventbridge_put, listen. Auth secrets access_key_id, secret_access_key, optional session_token are instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: bucket_create | bucket_delete | bucket_list | object_get | object_put | object_delete | object_copy | object_list | lambda_invoke | sqs_send | sqs_receive | sqs_delete | sns_publish | dynamodb_get | dynamodb_put | dynamodb_query | ses_send | iam_get | iam_get_role | secretsmanager_get | cloudwatch_put | ecs_run | sts_assume | eventbridge_put | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'bucket_create'.

schema.label: Bucket
schema.description: S3 bucket name for bucket_* and object_*. Example: invoices-prod.

schema.label: Key
schema.description: S3 object key for object_get / object_put / object_delete / object_copy. Example: reports/2026/q1.pdf. For DynamoDB use ItemKey.

schema.label: FunctionName
schema.description: Lambda function name or ARN for lambda_invoke. Example: invoice-handler.

schema.label: Payload
schema.description: Lambda event for lambda_invoke, sent as the whole JSON request body. Any JSON object the function expects. Example: {"orderId":"1001","action":"refund"}.

schema.label: Body
schema.description: Object bytes for object_put (PUT /{Bucket}/{Key}, bodyFormat raw). String or platform file ref-id. Empty sends a 0-byte object. Also set acl / storage_class / server_side_encryption / tagging headers.

schema.label: CopySource
schema.description: x-amz-copy-source for object_copy: /sourceBucket/sourceKey. Required. Example: /invoices-prod/old.pdf.

schema.label: list-type
schema.description: S3 ListObjectsV2 list-type for object_list. Send 2.

schema.label: prefix
schema.description: S3 key prefix for object_list. Example: reports/.

schema.label: QueueUrl
schema.description: SQS queue URL for sqs_send / sqs_receive / sqs_delete. Example: https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123/orders.

schema.label: MessageBody
schema.description: SQS message body for sqs_send. Example: {"order":1}.

schema.label: ReceiptHandle
schema.description: SQS receipt handle for sqs_delete (from ReceiveMessage).

schema.label: TopicArn
schema.description: SNS topic ARN for sns_publish. Set exactly one of TopicArn, TargetArn or PhoneNumber. Example: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:alerts.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: SNS message for sns_publish. Example: deploy finished.

schema.label: TargetArn
schema.description: SNS mobile endpoint ARN for sns_publish (direct push to one device). Use instead of TopicArn / PhoneNumber. Example: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:endpoint/APNS/app/abc123.

schema.label: PhoneNumber
schema.description: E.164 phone number for an SMS sns_publish. Use instead of TopicArn / TargetArn. Example: +14155550100.

schema.label: TableName
schema.description: DynamoDB table name for dynamodb_get / dynamodb_put / dynamodb_query. Example: customers.

schema.label: ItemKey
schema.description: DynamoDB primary key attribute map for dynamodb_get, sent as body Key. Include the partition key (and sort key if the table has one) in DynamoDB attribute-value format. Example: {"id":{"S":"1"}}.

schema.label: Item
schema.description: DynamoDB PutItem Item attribute map for dynamodb_put. Example: {"id":{"S":"1"},"name":{"S":"Ada"}}.

schema.label: KeyConditionExpression
schema.description: DynamoDB Query KeyConditionExpression for dynamodb_query. Example: id = :id.

schema.label: ExpressionAttributeValues
schema.description: Values for the :placeholders in KeyConditionExpression for dynamodb_query, in DynamoDB attribute-value format. Example: {":id":{"S":"1"}}.

schema.label: Source
schema.description: SES Source (From) email for ses_send. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: ToAddress
schema.description: Recipient email for ses_send (Destination.ToAddresses.member.1). One address. Example: bob@example.com.

schema.label: Subject
schema.description: Email subject for ses_send (Message.Subject.Data). Required. Example: Your invoice is ready.

schema.label: TextBody
schema.description: Plain-text body for ses_send (Message.Body.Text.Data). Set TextBody, HtmlBody or both. Example: Hi Bob, your invoice is attached.

schema.label: HtmlBody
schema.description:
HTML body for ses_send (Message.Body.Html.Data). Set TextBody, HtmlBody or both. Example:

Hi Bob, your invoice is ready.

schema.label: UserName
schema.description: IAM user name for iam_get. Empty returns the user that owns the access key. Example: deploy-bot.

schema.label: RoleName
schema.description: IAM role name (not ARN) for iam_get_role. Required for that operation. Example: DeployRole.

schema.label: SecretId
schema.description: Secrets Manager name or ARN for secretsmanager_get. Example: prod/db.

schema.label: Namespace
schema.description: CloudWatch metric namespace for cloudwatch_put. Example: StudioQuack/App.

schema.label: MetricName
schema.description: CloudWatch metric name for cloudwatch_put (MetricData.member.1.MetricName). One datapoint per call. Example: Latency.

schema.label: MetricValue
schema.description: Datapoint value for cloudwatch_put (MetricData.member.1.Value). Example: 12.

schema.label: MetricUnit
schema.description: Unit for cloudwatch_put (MetricData.member.1.Unit). EXACT common: Seconds | Milliseconds | Bytes | Count | Percent | None. Example: Milliseconds.

schema.label: cluster
schema.description: ECS cluster name or ARN for ecs_run. Example: prod.

schema.label: taskDefinition
schema.description: ECS task definition family:revision or ARN for ecs_run. Example: web:3.

schema.label: RoleArn
schema.description: IAM role ARN for sts_assume. Example: arn:aws:iam::123:role/Deploy.

schema.label: RoleSessionName
schema.description: STS session name for sts_assume. Example: studioquack.

schema.label: Entries
schema.description: EventBridge PutEvents Entries array for eventbridge_put. Example: [{"Source":"app","DetailType":"order","Detail":"{}","EventBusName":"default"}].

schema.label: acl
schema.description: x-amz-acl on object_put. EXACT: private | public-read | public-read-write | authenticated-read | aws-exec-read | bucket-owner-read | bucket-owner-full-control. Example: private.

schema.label: storage_class
schema.description: x-amz-storage-class on object_put. EXACT: STANDARD | STANDARD_IA | ONEZONE_IA | INTELLIGENT_TIERING | GLACIER | DEEP_ARCHIVE | GLACIER_IR. Example: STANDARD.

schema.label: server_side_encryption
schema.description: x-amz-server-side-encryption on object_put. EXACT: AES256 | aws:kms | aws:kms:dsse. Example: AES256.

schema.label: tagging
schema.description: x-amz-tagging on object_put (URL-encoded key=value). Example: project=alpha.

schema.label: Content
schema.description: SESv2 SendEmail Content for ses_send (Simple/Html/Template). Example: {"Simple":{"Subject":{"Data":"Hi"},"Body":{"Text":{"Data":"Hello"}}}}.

schema.label: Destination
schema.description: SESv2 Destination for ses_send (ToAddresses/CcAddresses/BccAddresses). Example: {"ToAddresses":["bob@example.com"]}.

schema.label: FromEmailAddress
schema.description: SESv2 FromEmailAddress for ses_send (sender). Example: alice@example.com.

schema.label: MetricData
schema.description: CloudWatch PutMetricData MetricData array for cloudwatch_put. Example: [{"MetricName":"Latency","Value":12,"Unit":"Milliseconds"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: bucket_create, bucket_delete, bucket_list, object_get, object_put, object_delete, object_copy, object_list, lambda_invoke, sqs_send, sqs_receive, sqs_delete, sns_publish, dynamodb_get, dynamodb_put, dynamodb_query, ses_send, iam_get, iam_get_role, secretsmanager_get, cloudwatch_put, ecs_run, sts_assume, eventbridge_put, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Access Key
configurationParameters.description: AWS secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key Id
configurationParameters.description: AWS access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Session Token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Service
configurationParameters.description: SigV4 service code for this instance. Must match the operation family: s3 | lambda | sqs | sns | dynamodb | ses | iam | secretsmanager | monitoring | ecs | sts | events. Literal service in the spec is not set — this config is used.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Content
configurationParameters.description: SESv2 SendEmail Content for ses_send (Simple/Html/Template). Example: {"Simple":{"Subject":{"Data":"Hi"},"Body":{"Text":{"Data":"Hello"}}}}.

configurationParameters.label: FromEmailAddress
configurationParameters.description: SESv2 FromEmailAddress for ses_send (sender). Example: alice@example.com.

configurationParameters.label: MetricData
configurationParameters.description: CloudWatch PutMetricData MetricData array for cloudwatch_put. Example: [{"MetricName":"Latency","Value":12,"Unit":"Milliseconds"}].
